note: Triennial rural district council election. Voting in Tyrone took place on Wednesday 31 May 1933. The Lislea division was the only contested rural district division in the Strabane union; the rest were filled at the nominations. Filed on 1933-05-31, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Tyrone that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1933-06-01 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Dunn, of Aghalane, Plumbridge, the retiring Unionist representative; Orr, of Edenmill, Plumbridge, the official Unionist candidate. Majority 35. The division included part of the village of Plumbridge.
